value.rationale: The invariant product labels every neutral ecological cycle and its original-time period is the natural quantitative invariant of the one-parameter orbit foliation. A strict no-turning law for all amplitudes, exact lower endpoint and high-amplitude logarithmic asymptotic distinguish short neutral oscillations from arbitrarily slow near-heteroclinic cycles. The first correction and normalization are structurally meaningful and not arbitrary finite cutoffs. Generalized elliptic period methods do not by themselves answer this dynamical time-scale question.
